name: DJ Beli
description: DJ Beli plays a set featuring jackin house, indie dance, and deep tech house at Big Bad Bank Bar in Porto.
longDescription:
DJ Beli takes over the music at Big Bad Bank Bar, located at Rua do Ateneu Comercial do Porto, 13. The set includes a mix of jackin house, indie dance, and deep tech house.

The party takes place on 21 November 2026, running from 23:00 until 02:00. Admission is free.
